title: Binary encoding of the Jacobi symbol
statement: For a Boolean word $z$, take the Jacobi symbol of the values of the two components decoded from $z$, add $1$, convert the result to a natural number, and represent that natural number by its binary digits.
caveat: The pair decoder and Boolean-word value convention are not defined in the supplied statement.
